name: Thorns & Roses
source:
In this game, you play as an agent named Lee who is a part of a force team named S.T.R.I.K.E. Lee must choose between her loyalty to S.T.R.I.K.E. and the beautiful yet dangerous Rose, whom she has been ordered to kill. 

[From [url=https://xmangosagox.itch.io/thorns-roses]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，你扮演一名名叫Lee的特工，他是一支名为S.T.R.I.K.E的部队的一员。李必须在对S.T.R.I.K.E的忠诚和对S.T.R.I.K.E的忠诚之间做出选择。还有美丽但危险的罗丝，她被命令杀死她。

[来自[url=https://xmangosagox.itch.io/thorns-roses]Itch.io[/url]]
